title: [finding] os init and os compile print a refusal twice across two streams: a printError line on stdout, then this.error re-renders the same sentence as oclif's Error block on stderr
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position**, a `finding` of class (a).
- `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21523 dev at `549f3704e4` (os-dev report on #21523, out-of-scope finding 1; PR #21541).
- Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes it. The position is `packages/cli` (`domain:cli`).

## What happens (measured, public door)

`os init demo -t bogus` prints `✗ Unknown template: bogus` on stdout, then oclif's `›   Error: Unknown template: bogus` on stderr, and exits 2. One refusal's sentence is read twice, across two streams.

## Why (read from source at `origin/main`)

- 8 sites under `packages/cli/src/commands` pair `printError(msg)` with `this.error(msg)`, and `this.error` makes oclif's entry point render the same sentence again:
  - in `init.ts`: the 5 refusals before the `try`, and the catch-all;
  - in `compile.ts`: the bundling refusal (about :1045–1046) and the catch-all (about :1216–1217).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts`'s `isReportedError` docblock names this exact outcome as the defect it exists to stop ("the operator would … read one refusal twice across two streams", #15547 / #15692). The pairing sites do not use it.
- This is NOT the exit-signal family (#21434, #21496, #21523). That family re-reported a signal from a `catch`. Here the command renders the sentence itself and also hands it to oclif to render.

## Direction (⛔ not a ruling)

One rendering per refusal, by the split #15692 established. Either the command prints the `✗` line and raises with `this.exit(n)`, or it raises with `this.error` and prints nothing itself, or it uses the `isReportedError` shape. ⛔ No second mechanism. Pins: each of the 8 refusals renders its sentence once at the public door, with its exit status unchanged.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed: 「printError then this.error refusal printed twice stdout stderr oclif Error block」 gave 1 hit, #21523, which is the exit-signal re-report from a `catch`, a different mechanism. None covers this.

Dedupe words: printError then this.error; os init refusal printed twice stdout stderr; oclif Error block repeats the ✗ line; Unknown template printed twice.
